className.description: The name of the exception class.

message.description: The error message associated with the exception.

stackTrace.description: The individual stack frames, with the innermost one first.

cause.description: The exception that caused this one to be thrown. This in turn has a class, message and stack trace.

lineNumber.description:
The first line number of the printed exception in the source file. This is where the exception class name appears.
This is only set when exceptions are read from a file such as #readFromFile.

title:
An exception stack trace includes information about the exception, its stack trace, as well as the chain of
cause exceptions.

```
c3.platform.stuff.BadStuff: Bad stuff happened!
  at c3.platform.stuff.Stuff.doStuff(Stuff.java:40)
  at c3.platform.Main.run(Main.java:10)
Caused by: java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: NaN
  at java.base/java.lang.NumberFormatException.forInputString(NumberFormatException.java:67)
  at java.base/java.lang.Integer.parseInt(Integer.java:668)
  ... 59 more
```

Note that this example actually has _two_ {@link ThreadStackTrace stack traces}, one for the outer and one for the
inner (cause) exception.

@see ThreadStackTrace
name: ExceptionStackTrace
